description.en: Database structure the agent already knows: dbgraph indexes a remote database catalog (tables, columns, comments, keys, indexes, bounded enum samples) into a local SQLite index and puts a digest in the system prompt, so structural questions are answered offline and row values are fetched with exactly one query.
description.zh: 把数据库结构提前索引好：dbgraph 将远端库的 catalog（表、字段、注释、键、索引与有限的枚举样本）索引到本地 SQLite，并把摘要注入系统提示，结构问题本地答、取数只发一次查询。
